queries.text:
SELECT account_id, metric, sum(quantity) AS q FROM billing.usage WHERE day >= current_date - $1::int
				GROUP BY account_id, metric ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT id, amount, state FROM billing.invoices WHERE account_id = $1 ORDER BY issued_at DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT paid_at, amount FROM billing.payments WHERE invoice_id = $1
SELECT plan, balance FROM billing.accounts WHERE id = $1
UPDATE billing.accounts SET balance = balance + $2 WHERE id = $1

SELECT id, plan FROM billing.accounts WHERE id = ANY($1)
